purpose: The surface an agent shapes on the person's page while they watch: blocks in a few places, bound to data the page already reads, changed by small atomic operations that the page draws at once and answers with what it drew. The rules live in tos-web-rules (surface.rs) and run the same in the browser and at the bridge.
authority_limit: A surface changes what this page shows and nothing else. It never writes ToS source, review, rights or canon; it writes an act only when someone keeps it; it never covers the person's own controls; it carries text, addresses and choices from this contract, never markup, styles, scripts or outside links. Every block is framed as the work of who shaped it, and the person can freeze, undo or clear it at any time.

places.name: dock
places.shows: a panel beside the space (a sheet on a phone) headed by the surface's title and who shapes it

places.name: strip
places.shows: one row above the space for short facts and buttons

places.name: card
places.shows: blocks at the end of the open card of a subject; a parameter "$selected" reads the subject the card shows

places.name: sky
places.shows: the agent's light on the sky, named in its own chip: stars that stand out and links that brighten; with dim_rest the rest steps back

blocks.shows: a paragraph; with bind, {field} in the text reads the first row
one number or short fact with its label; with bind, field names the row field (default: the number of rows)
rows as lines: title and meta are templates over a row; target is a template giving the subject a click selects
rows as a table; columns are {field, title}
a bar for each row: label is a template, value a numeric field
subjects as chips that select them: members are addresses, or a bind with label and target templates
a button that runs one page command when the person presses it
a titled group of blocks, open or folded
stars that stand out on the sky: members are addresses, or a bind with a target template
links that brighten on the sky: relations are relation addresses, or a bind with a target template

sources.name: journal

params.view: a fold of the act journal: summary, act, target, board, review, decided, leases, presence, history, kinds, squads

sources.rows: the fold as tos.act.query returns it, read up to 1000 rows; path picks a list inside it

params.query: words to find in the stand's research index

sources.name: item
sources.rows: one row: the subject with its dependencies and backlinks

sources.name: selected
sources.rows: one row: the selected subject {id, kind, label} or none

sources.name: view
sources.rows: one row: the presence layer, lens, route and step, workbench

sources.name: field
sources.rows: the agents' field items as field-shapes.v1 draws them

transforms.path: a dotted path to the list inside the source's answer ("groups", "squads", "items")
transforms.where: a list of {field, op, value}; op is eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, has or in
transforms.count_by: a field: rows become {value, count}, most first
transforms.limit: rows kept after the rest, 1 to the limit below; 50 when absent

templates: {field} or {field.sub} reads a row; {#} is the row's number from 1; a missing field reads as nothing and is named in the answer

ops.does: add a block or replace the one with its id; in names the place (dock when absent), parent a group; after, before or at place it; a replaced block keeps its position unless another place or position is given
set one field of a block by a dotted name (title, bind.limit, columns); a null value removes it
move a block to another place or position
remove a block with what it holds
remove every block of a place, or of the whole surface
